findings: After refreshProgressLease yields or sets state.active=false, simulate continues without checking state.active again. PlayerRemoving may have removed the session and entities, but resumed simulate can still add models or mutate coins. Add a post-refresh active/session guard and canonical delayed-refresh/foreign-owner regressions with pinned c7227654 negative control.
